principles.name: Truth through the chain
principles.rule: No material claim without traceable product- or batch-linked support.

principles.name: Release by documented standard
principles.rule: No sale or shipment before the acceptance standard passes and the evidence record is complete.

principles.name: Informed choice
principles.rule: Material limitations, variation, origin, composition, care, and expected behaviour remain visible and accurate.

principles.name: Responsibility for mismatch
principles.rule: Contain, investigate, communicate, and perform the approved remedy.

principles.name: Controlled deepening
principles.rule: Deeper production control requires its own traceability, quality, legal, economic, and capacity gates.

principles.name: Growth within the promise
principles.rule: No expansion beyond proven release, cash, people, support, and external capacity.

principles.name: Human dignity
principles.rule: No source path may depend on coercion, exploitation, deception, forced labour, child labour, or unestablished legitimacy.

principles.name: 30 / 60 / 100 multiplication
principles.rule: The 30 level is the minimum return standard; below it triggers review and blocks growth commitments.

principles.name: Addition releases multiplication
principles.rule: A non-founding hire or consultant requires a documented credible path to 10x multiplication.

principles.name: Creator stewardship remains controlling
principles.rule: Creator ownership may not fall below 51 percent.

principles.name: Founding return endures
principles.rule: Founder return remains separate from current labour and is distributed only from confirmed surplus after obligations.

principles.name: Quality mark inseparable from the standard
principles.rule: No mark use may be separated from FH-P1 through FH-P4 evidence and accountability.

products.name: The Body Wave
limitations: Concept only; no product has been released.
